Self-hosted webfonts
====================

Both families are served from this folder. Nothing here is loaded from a CDN —
see AGENTS.md section 3. Each family ships its own SIL Open Font License 1.1
text alongside the woff2 files.


Plus Jakarta Sans  (Latin UI + body face, both locales)
-------------------------------------------------------
Version:  v12 (Google Fonts release, fetched 2026-08-25)
Source:   https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Plus+Jakarta+Sans
Upstream: https://github.com/tokotype/PlusJakartaSans
Licence:  SIL Open Font License 1.1 — plus-jakarta-sans/LICENSE.txt
Files:    plus-jakarta-sans-latin.woff2, plus-jakarta-sans-latin-ext.woff2

  Google Fonts serves one variable-weight woff2 per subset for this family, so
  the five weights the site uses (400/500/600/700/800) are declared as a single
  `font-weight: 400 800` range rather than five identical files. Subsets are
  limited to latin and latin-ext; the site has no Cyrillic or Vietnamese copy.

  This replaces the fonts.googleapis.com <link> the header carried previously.
  The family, the weights and the rendered output are unchanged — only the
  origin moved from Google's CDN to this repo.


IBM Plex Sans Arabic  (Arabic face, ar locale only)
----------------------------------------------------
Version:  v15 (Google Fonts release, fetched 2026-08-25)
Source:   https://fonts.google.com/specimen/IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic
Upstream: https://github.com/IBM/plex
Licence:  SIL Open Font License 1.1 — ibm-plex-sans-arabic/LICENSE.txt
Files:    ibm-plex-sans-arabic-{400,500,600,700}-{arabic,latin,latin-ext}.woff2

  Static instances, one file per weight per subset. The latin subsets are kept
  so mixed Arabic/Latin runs (an email address, a SAR figure, a tour slug) stay
  in one type family instead of falling back mid-sentence.

  Chosen for its close match to Plus Jakarta Sans: near-identical x-height,
  a humanist sans skeleton, and a matching 400-700 weight range, so a shared
  stylesheet renders at the same optical size in both directions.

  Loaded only on Arabic pages — header.php adds this stylesheet when
  alam_locale_is_rtl() is true, so English pages download none of it.


Re-fetching
-----------
There is no npm step. To refresh a family, request the CSS from the Google
Fonts css2 API with a desktop User-Agent (which selects woff2), download each
`src: url(...)` it names, and rewrite the URLs to the local filenames:

  curl -A "<desktop UA>" \
    "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"

Keep only the subsets listed above, and update the version line here.
